programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?! - Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn’t like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Once there was a girl called Anya who was very scared of insects! One day Anya’s mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! She was on the edge of despair when her little brother proved to her, that little crumbs can’t be of any danger to giants like children!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Alert! Bear’s fridge is in danger! Someone has burst into his house to stay for life…but the Bear is ready for everything to defend his stocks! He calls for a savior, but in reality it turns to be a new intriguing story full of unexpected discoveries which leads Masha to some peculiar conclusions!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The technologies some time can teach us a human lesson like in this story about two robots. One of them was presented to Masha for her birthday and the other one was made by the Bear to help him around, but tried to become the boss. Everything turned into great mess and only an unexpectedly awakened feeling between two robots put everything in its place.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.desc: Panda- the Bear’s distant relative pays one more visit to the Bear. They start making Chinese dump-lings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And a simple cooking turns into a culinary master class with butterflies!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one’s pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it’s all because she was hard-working and clean.

And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha’s new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories

programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. Oh yeah!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat’s voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. - One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds’ language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.desc: This fairy tale is about one little and witty tailor, who had a chance to defeat the giant and obtain a fridge full of sweets. So he ate all of them at once. Then he decided to get out on the street, but could not, as he overate and got stuck in the door. This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much; otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Who is the best cook in all the forest? Masha has no doubts as to how to correctly answer this question. And the proof is right before you: macaroni cooked by Masha herself. What can be simpler? Only Dasha is somehow sure that Masha's final product is inedible. As usual, Bear will have to solve the girls' dispute, as usual.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Isabelle, en compagnie de Ricardo, prépare une tarte au citron et au pavot meringuée. Elle nous montre aussi comment réaliser une cuisson à blanc avec des pois de cuisson.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "La famille Claveau-Audet construit une couche froide et revalorise ses hémérocalles en les offrant aux voisins. La brigade de l'Académie des Sacrés-Coeurs fait du vermicompostage, détourbe le potager et Édith découvre son projet d'hydroponie."

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: La Recette de Guy Martin S08
programme.desc: Le chef étoilé Guy Martin présente les produits emblématiques du terroir français et propose une recette pour les accommoder.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: A journey rich in flavour through the regions and their terroirs, exploring local specialities and meeting the artisans perpetuating their age-old culinary traditions. An opportunity to stop off in the kitchen of a talented chef to prepare an emblematic regional recipe.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: Au Nouveau-Brunswick, le chef Michel Savoie concocte une langue de boeuf, issue de la ferme Boudreau, des légumes de saison de la ferme La Belle Besogne et des micro-verdures de culture hydroponique de Local by Atta.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Annick Jeanmairet et Simon Romang vous proposent du cabillaud aux lentilles vertes, lard valaisan et vinaigrette de moules. Découverte du jour : la pêche au silure, un poisson mal aimé et pourtant très bon.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Isabelle concocte l'accompagnement idéal pour un dîner d'automne : des petits pains au lait et un beurre à l'ail noir. On en apprend aussi davantage sur ce dernier ingrédient.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "La famille Claveau-Audet participe à l'événement Mai sans tondeuse et plante du trèfle. Véronique réalise son rêve en agrandissant le potager. C'est sous la pluie que les élèves de l'Académie débutent leur journée de plantation avec Dany."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo propose une rencontre culinaire entre la Côte d'Ivoire et le Maroc, avec un plat mêlant attiéké, poisson mariné au citron confit, huile d'argan et raisins secs. Une ode à la diversité africaine !

programme.title: Ton plat mon plat
programme.desc: Web-série qui valorise les aliments et les condiments de la gastronomie africaine dans une ambiance cosy, détendue et interactive.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Cheffe incontournable de la gastronomie au Maroc, Myriam Ettahri nous reçoit chez elle pour nous fait découvrir Taghazout Bay et la région d'Agadir, un terroir haut en couleurs et en saveurs. L'occasion de rencontrer la fine fleur de la gastronomie marocaine et française.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: "La chef Fisun Ercan, au Québec, offre un plat inspiré par la cuisine turque, avec des gourganes de Légunord, le verjus d'Au fil du vent et les artichauts de la ferme La Fille du Roy."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: "Au menu : gnocchis de potimarron, sauce crème parmesan ail. Et quelques poires pochées au caramel. Découverte du jour : une formule antigaspi pour valoriser le résidu issu de l'huile de noix : le nillon."

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: La saison du chou-fleur est presque terminée ! Isabelle le propose façon « steak » épicé, sauce ranch au tahini ainsi que dans une trempette aux haricots blancs avec de l'ail rôti.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "Ça pousse chez les Claveau-Audet ! La famille poursuit ses plantations et découvre les strophaires. La température permet finalement aux élèves de planter de bons légumes qui serviront à la confection de leur sauce spaghetti."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo nous fait voyager entre l'Asie et l'Orient avec des rouleaux de feuille de riz garnis de pommes, cannelle et raisins secs. Une explosion sucré-salé, légère et raffinée !

programme.title: Ton plat mon plat

programme.title: Papilles

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: "À Ottawa, le chef Marc Lepine propose un plat de viande de wapiti d'Elk Ranch, avec de la fleur d'ail de la ferme Ail Mayo Hill Garlic et le navet hakurei de Backyard Edibles."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Au menu : blanquette de veau à la fève tonka. Découverte du jour : beef jerky 100 % local, artisanal, sans additifs.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Quand les légumes se font généreux et colorés ! Isabelle cuisine un macaroni au fromage à la courge ainsi qu'une salade de roquette à la truite et aux betteraves jaunes.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "C'est les pieds dans la boue que les élèves de l'Académie poursuivent leurs travaux. Les Claveau-Audet plantent des fraises en balconnière et, avec Édith, offrent des plantations à un organisme de Terrebonne."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo mixe traditions marocaines, italiennes et indiennes, avec une recette originale : langues d'oiseau, épices exotiques et parmesan dans un risotto vegan délicieux !

programme.title: Ton plat mon plat

programme.title: Papilles

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "Édith et les élèves de l'Académie des Sacrés-Coeurs introduisent une ruche, des plantes pollinisatrices et un hôtel d'insectes à leur potager. Véronique et Bryan plantent des légumes antillais. La mi-saison est le temps idéal pour les successions."

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca da una conferencia de prensa polémica donde afirma que desde su regreso está mejor que nunca con Leonardo y que planea volver a su familia y trabajo como la legítima señora Ferrándiz que nunca dejó de ser. Ante esto Irene decide definitivamente anular su matrimonio con Leonardo y no quiere decirle nada sobre su bebé. Leonardo entristecido por su crisis con Irene, enfurece con lo que hizo Rebeca. Por otro lado, Carlos Ernesto y Virginia descubren más cosas sospechosas sobre el regreso de Rebeca, y él cada vez confía menos en ella por lo que decide viajar hasta la isla donde estuvo Rebeca y buscar información. Agustina también sospecha que Rebeca está ocultando algo y que eso comenzó mucho antes del accidente.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe e Irene son interrumpidos por Paula, quien luego mantiene una charla con Irene pidiéndole que se alejara de Felipe para no hacerlo sufrir y que lo deje ser feliz al lado de otra persona. Carlos Ernesto tiene fuertes sospechas por la reaparición de Rebecca y decide emprender un viaje hacia la isla para obtener información del hospital en donde se trataba. Se lo lleva a Tony con él y deja a Maribel como informante en la empresa. Alejandra los vio conversando a los tres y tiene dudas de que se traigan algo entre manos. Rebecca recibe la visita de su padrino Adolfo con quien al parecer tienen un plan para obtener la fortuna de los Ferrandiz.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela deja a Ricardo tras descubrir su engaño con Celia y su hija Elizabeth. Mientras Celia celebra su éxito, Ricardo intenta recuperarla sin éxito y enfrenta la furia de Margot. Marcelo revela que ya sabía la verdad, provocando mayor tensión. Paralelamente, Misael es amenazado por criminales y Elizabeth confronta a su madre, quien admite haber enviado la foto reveladora. Desesperado, Ricardo promete eliminar a Celia de su vida definitivamente para intentar recuperar a Manuela.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela descubre que Ricardo tiene una hija de 14 años con Celia, una mujer considerada peligrosa por su entorno. René admite que conocía el secreto y Manuela lo perdona, mientras Joyce la aconseja no abandonar su relación todavía. En un arranque de ira, Ricardo intenta ahorcar a Celia por el envío de una foto, pero Elizabeth se culpa para protegerla. Finalmente, Hortensia se entera de la verdad sobre su nieta y acepta recibirla en su hogar.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Marcelo intenta salvar el matrimonio de Ricardo y Manuela, mientras Katiuska y Verónica planean separarlos tras la partida de Graciela. Ricardo casi mata a Celia por sus intrigas, pero regresa con Manuela para darle otra oportunidad. Elizabeth enferma y es llevada al médico por Ricardo. Margot confronta a Hortensia, y Misael recurre a Manuela para rescatar a su sobrino Gregory. Finalmente, el Padre Alejandro usa sus habilidades de karate para rescatar al niño de unos delincuentes.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Margot le revela a Moisés que Malaver es su padre, mientras la abuela de Moisés lo niega. Ricardo rompe definitivamente con Celia, quien descubre que está embarazada de él. Jade nota un lunar en Moisés que confirma que es hermano de Elizabeth. Katiuska manipula a Manuela para que busque a Celia. Finalmente, Ricardo y Manuela tienen una fuerte discusión donde ella le exige jurar que nunca tuvo una relación con Celia, dejando a Ricardo sin palabras.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela obliga a Ricardo a alejarse de Celia, quien cree estar embarazada. Hortensia descubre que Elizabeth es su nieta y se enorgullece de ella. Michelle ingresa a desintoxicación y Gregory conoce parte de la verdad sobre su madre. En la clínica, Celia provoca a Manuela hablándole de su supuesta maternidad. Ricardo se acerca a Elizabeth regalándole un celular, mientras Manuela rechaza tajantemente convivir con la hija de su esposo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carmen exige a Rosa no ver más a Junior por ser responsable de la muerte de Carlos. Junior golpea a Isaías al descubrirlo como acompañante nocturno de Maricela. Adolfo acorrala a Consuelo, quien confiesa entre lágrimas que tuvieron una hija perdida tras el embarazo. Rosalía descubre que Rosa trabaja en la tienda y la despide humillándola. Arminda, disfrazada, envenena el café de Blanca mientras Chencha la deja sola. Robert es elegido para una película por Amalia. La maldad de Erasto y Arminda continúa, cada vez más cerca de destruir todo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Blanca convulsiona repentinamente en pleno brindis y René la lleva urgente a la clínica reconociendo síntomas de envenenamiento. Arminda festeja con Erasto la supuesta muerte de Blanca. Erasto trae a Natalia a su casa y la humilla obligándola a quitarle los zapatos y desnudarlo. Arminda y Eustoquio quedan furiosos por distintas razones. Junior pide ayuda a Rosalía para separar a Rosa de Alejandro. Adolfo entra a un bar pensando en Consuelo sin tomar. Rosalía se insinúa a Alejandro al quedar solos en casa, marcando otro paso decisivo del engaño.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo visita a Erasto y le reprocha haber ocultado la existencia de su hija con Consuelo; Erasto lo expulsa. José Luis informa a la residencia que Blanca fue envenenada y Carmen acusa a la "amiga rara". Consuelo echa a Isaías tras llevarlo Rosa ebrio. Amalia descubre que Alejandro pasó la noche con Rosalía. Natalia confiesa a Mildred las humillaciones que vivió con Erasto. Carmen va a casa de Arminda a gritarle en la cara que ella envenenó a Blanca, pero que sigue viva. Maricela teme que Adolfo quiera quitarle su empresa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe e Irene son interrumpidos por Paula, quien luego mantiene una charla con Irene pidiéndole que se alejara de Felipe para no hacerlo sufrir y que lo deje ser feliz al lado de otra persona. Carlos Ernesto tiene fuertes sospechas por la reaparición de Rebecca y decide emprender un viaje hacia la isla para obtener información del hospital en donde se trataba. programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Alejandro tienen un par de encuentros en los que se ven en paños menores a lo que ambos responden con indiferencia tratando de ocultar sus emociones, hasta que Alejandro entra en la pieza de Sol y la besa y le dice que la desea. Sol le dice que no niega sentir algo por él pero que al mismo tiempo lo odia por no haber reconocido a su hija. Que por eso no va a pasar nada entre ellos. Eloy le propone matrimonio a Columba, luego aparece José Domingo y les desea la mejor de las suertes.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri sintiéndose perseguida por el recuerdo de Wilker desaprovecha la oportunidad de estar íntimamente con Juan Diego al rehusarse a ser parte de su seducción. En el restaurante Briggite conversa con Carolina al intentar tranquilizarla tras ser testigo de la desaparición de Juan Diego del lugar | Carolina desahoga su frustración en contra de su madre al saberla envuelta en un insistente coqueteo con Armando | Carolina hace valer sus sospechas al presentir a Juan Diego y Yubiri juntos.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Aureliano confiesa a Dileidy que intenta superarse para merecerla. Gerson se siente asfixiado por Cristina. Paco aprovecha y culpa a Doroteo de intentar asesinarle. Matilde nota que Monchito está celoso de Pascuita.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela obliga a Ricardo a alejarse de Celia, quien cree estar embarazada. Hortensia descubre que Elizabeth es su nieta y se enorgullece de ella. Michelle ingresa a desintoxicación y Gregory conoce parte de la verdad sobre su madre. En la clínica, Celia provoca a Manuela hablándole de su supuesta maternidad. Ricardo se acerca a Elizabeth regalándole un celular, mientras Manuela rechaza tajantemente convivir con la hija de su esposo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Blanca recobra la memoria al despertar en la clínica reconociendo a Chencha y René. Alejandro persigue a Rosa y logra reconciliarse aclarando los enredos con Junior. Isaías regresa con Consuelo pidiendo perdón; ella lo acepta. Adolfo espera a Consuelo con el detective contratado. José Luis enfrenta a Erasto en la residencia, quien lo amenaza directamente. Arminda y Eustoquio conspiran contra Erasto al ver que no encuentra salida. Alejandro invita a Rosa al restaurant de un hotel para celebrar, sin sospechar que ese viaje desencadenará nuevos enfrentamientos con Rosalía y Amalia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe e Irene son interrumpidos por Paula, quien luego mantiene una charla con Irene pidiéndole que se alejara de Felipe para no hacerlo sufrir y que lo deje ser feliz al lado de otra persona. Carlos Ernesto tiene fuertes sospechas por la reaparición de Rebecca y decide emprender un viaje hacia la isla para obtener información del hospital en donde se trataba. Se lo lleva a Tony con él y deja a Maribel como informante en la empresa. Alejandra los vio conversando a los tres y tiene dudas de que se traigan algo entre manos. Rebecca recibe la visita de su padrino Adolfo con quien al parecer tienen un plan para obtener la fortuna de los Ferrandiz.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

Sol le dice que no niega sentir algo por él pero que al mismo tiempo lo odia por no haber reconocido a su hija. Que por eso no va a pasar nada entre ellos. Eloy le propone matrimonio a Columba, luego aparece José Domingo y les desea la mejor de las suertes.
